page.overview:
What is Puppet Crew?

The were a group of puppet-like animatronics, first appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic within the Theater.

They appear to be mechanically controlled puppets with built-in voice boxes. They will jumpscare the player if Arnold misses too many of the targets.

Roxy was made by Fiona Murray to give to her son, David Sean Murray, on his first birthday. The rest of the Puppet Crew were presumably made Fiona to have perform in Edwin Murray's Stage Manager software to investors. They are an automatic puppet show that is operated by an employee with a Springlock suit.

During the events of Secret of the Mimic, Arnold builds the Pirate Captain Springlock suit, and is sent into the Theater to operate the show. He has to shoot targets to progress the show forward. After Arnold is progressing though, the area starts falling apart, leading to an unstable environment. Once the show is completed, the Captain's stage platform collapses and Arnold falls with it on.
